card.name: Linking words before adverse-effect lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, to, as, are, include, commas) just before a list of symptoms or effects, mostly in overdosage and warning text for stimulant or beta-agonist drugs.

modes.label: Links before symptoms
modes.description: A small word such as of, to, as, or are comes right before named symptoms or effects.
modes.example: Avoid administration late in the evening due to the risk<< of>> insomnia.

modes.label: Commas in symptom lists
modes.description: A comma or e.g. inside a running list of signs like tachycardia or tremor.
modes.example: , hypertension or hypotension, tachycardia with rates up to 200 beats per minute, arrhythmia, nervousness<<,>> headache, tremor, dry mouth,

modes.label: Time span before hours
modes.description: A space before a number of hours in a rule about pilots and alcohol.
modes.example: after consuming any alcoholic beverage within<< >>8 hours.

card.writes: The promoted tokens (action, driving, dance) and suppressed tokens (food, eating) are mostly Chinese and give no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It fires on the small connecting words that come just before a list of side effects or overdose signs.
